image_description: A medium shot of an adult female orangutan sitting in green grass, holding a juvenile orangutan. The adult has long reddish-brown fur and lacks the prominent cheek pads of a mature male. The juvenile is clinging to the adult's chest/shoulder area. Both subjects are clearly visible against a naturalistic background.
